anchor.quote: The Enneagram was designed as a diagnostic tool

claims.rationale: The post asserts a singular original design purpose for the Enneagram without naming a lineage, text, period, or source; its heterogeneous history requires narrower attribution.

legacy.quote: "The Enneagram was designed as a diagnostic tool"
legacy.note: Historical claim judged as history; accurate framing of the Enneagram's therapeutic-diagnostic origins.

anchor.quote: something my nervous system does under stress

claims.rationale: The nervous-system-under-stress formulation is offered as a general mechanism rather than a situated observation and supplies no measure, conditions, or source.

legacy.quote: "something my nervous system does under stress"
legacy.note: Descriptive contrast (bodily habit vs. identity); causal direction preserved — observer primary, nervous system as instrument.

anchor.quote: a specific configuration of observer, body, and inertia

claims.rationale: The post maps the Noesis observer-body-inertia triad onto Enneagram types without separately tracing the Enneagram and Kha-Ba-La ingredients or declaring Noesis authorship.

legacy.quote: "a specific configuration of observer, body, and inertia"
legacy.note: Kha-Ba-La triad mapped onto Enneagram types; structures the three type dissections that follow.

anchor.quote: The nervous system runs cortisol-mediated awareness intensification

claims.rationale: A cortisol-mediated awareness mechanism and siege response are asserted causally for Type 5 without hormonal measures, population limits, conditions, or a source.

legacy.quote: "The nervous system runs cortisol-mediated awareness intensification"
legacy.note: Cortisol (chemistry) named as mediator of awareness; "what feels like thinking is actually a siege protocol" reduces experience to stress physiology, asserted as fact.

anchor.quote: Adrenaline-driven movement deployed where precision was needed

claims.rationale: The Type 8-to-adrenaline mechanism is asserted without a defined population, measure, comparison, conditions, or traceable evidence.

legacy.quote: "Adrenaline-driven movement deployed where precision was needed"
legacy.note: Unverified Type 8 ↔ adrenaline mechanism presented as settled; no observation or model framing offered.

claims.rationale: The Type 9-to-serotonin equilibrium mechanism is asserted without a defined population, measure, conditions, or source.

legacy.note: Unverified Type 9 ↔ serotonin mechanism presented as settled; popular-neuro framing stated as fact.

anchor.quote: Each type runs a dominant hormonal loop

claims.rationale: The claim that every Enneagram type has a dominant hormonal loop has no identified study, operational definition, population, or uncertainty.

legacy.quote: "Each type runs a dominant hormonal loop"
legacy.note: The general type→hormone mechanism claim; "chemical signature" correlate-language partially mitigates but the loop is asserted, not modeled.

anchor.quote: The Investigator's cortisol. Awareness intensification. Tragedy as the dominant lens — everything observed, nothing inhabited. The body contracts, the perimeter expands, the world becomes data to be analyzed from a safe distance.

claims.rationale: The Investigator-to-cortisol assignment and its behavioral consequences are stated as anatomy without measurements, scope, or a traceable source.

legacy.note: The explicit type→hormone assignments (5/cortisol, 8/adrenaline, 9/serotonin); an invented correspondence stated as anatomy.

claims.rationale: 'Geometric regulation' supplies mathematical precision-aura to the unsupported serotonin mapping but defines no geometry, operation, or consequential structure.

legacy.note: Math adjective as precision-vibe; no geometry, ratio, or structure shown. Removal changes nothing.

anchor.quote: Your type is the hormone your nervous system defaults to under load

claims.rationale: Equating type with a default hormone is an unmeasured causal identity; the explicit 'not metaphors' boundary prevents treating it as harmless analogy.

legacy.quote: "Your type is the hormone your nervous system defaults to under load"
legacy.note: Explicit safe-harbor breach: "These are not metaphors" (§5 flagged marker) upgrades the hormone mapping to literal mechanism; type identified with chemistry.

anchor.quote: The cortisol-mediated withdrawal gives way to adrenaline-informed engagement

claims.rationale: The cortisol-to-adrenaline transition is an unsupported endocrine gloss on the Enneagram integration direction, with no measures or source.

legacy.quote: "The cortisol-mediated withdrawal gives way to adrenaline-informed engagement"
legacy.note: Hormone mapping reused inside the (correct) integration-direction discussion; the gloss is asserted mechanism.

anchor.quote: Type 5 integrates toward 8: from observation to embodied action. The observer learns to inhabit the body, not just watch from it. The cortisol-mediated withdrawal gives way to adrenaline-informed engagement. Not replacing one defense with another — expanding the range.

claims.rationale: The Enneagram tradition is named, and the 5→8, 4→1, and 7→5 integration directions are faithfully represented and structurally used; the directional mapping and provenance pass independently of C011's hormone gloss.

legacy.note: Actual Enneagram point-line dynamics; all three integration arrows (5→8, 4→1, 7→5) are correct and structurally deployed.

anchor.quote: It runs real chemistry. It produces real behavior.

claims.rationale: The row combines a literal chemistry claim with a behavior claim under one universal 'real' assertion; the mechanisms require splitting, scoping, and separate evidence.

legacy.quote: "It runs real chemistry. It produces real behavior."
legacy.note: Closing reaffirmation of the literal-chemistry claim; depends on the unverified endocrine mapping.
